title: Koyaanisqatsi and the Physics of Disharmony

description: Analyses the Hopi idea of koyaanisqatsi ('life out of balance') through cultural reprogramming in boarding schools and resource extraction at Black Mesa, reading Hopi prophecy as cause-and-effect. A modern research presentation from the Acuity Institute collection.
